```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(googledrive)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(mnsentinellakes)
library(FSA) # for geomean() function
library(janitor) # for row_to_names() fucntion

# clear workspace
rm(list = ls())
```

```{r load data}

setwd("G:/My Drive/Research/beaches/data/processed")

trpd <- read.csv("TRPD_081125.csv") %>%
  # mutate(DOW = fixlakeid(DOW)) %>% # doesn't work for NAs
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))

mprb <- read.csv("MPRB_Ecoli_081125.csv") %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))



ramco <- read.csv("RamseyCo_081125.csv") %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))

henco <- read.csv("HennepinCo_100225.csv") %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))
henco <- unique(henco)

dakco  <- read.csv("DakotaCo_092325.csv") %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))
  
wrico <- read.csv("WrightCo_120925.csv") %>% 
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))



blaine <- read.csv("Blaine_081125_bf.csv") %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y")) 

burnsville <- read.csv("MSP-beaches_Burnsville_clean.csv") %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))

minnetonka <- read.csv("MSP-beaches_Minnetonka_clean.csv") %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  select(-Notes)

woodbury <- read.csv("Woodbury_091725.csv") %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%Y-%m-%d")) %>%
  rename(Date = date) %>%
  select(-units)

lakeville <- read.csv("Lakeville_091825.csv") %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))

# bloomington <- read.csv("______________.csv") %>% # still needs to be organized
#   mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
#   mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))
 
elkriver <- read.csv("ElkRiver_111425.csv") %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))



priorlake1 <- read.csv("PriorLake1_091725_fixed.csv") %>%
  select(-Ecoli_units) %>%
  rename(Ecoli_units = units) %>%
  rename(Date = date) %>%
  rename(BeachName = beach_name) %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))

priorlake2 <- read.csv("PriorLake2_091725.csv") %>%
  rename(Date = date) %>%
  rename(BeachName = beach_name) %>%
  mutate(DOW = as.character(DOW)) %>%
  mutate(Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"))

priorlake <- rbind(priorlake1, priorlake2)

rm(priorlake1, priorlake2)


```

```{r combine}

all_beaches <- rbind(trpd, mprb, ramco, dakco, henco, wrico, blaine, burnsville, bloomington, lakeville, minnetonka, woodbury, elkriver, priorlake)



all_beaches <- all_beaches %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Ecoli_1dGM))


str(all_beaches)
summary(all_beaches)

```

```{r write to file}
getwd()

setwd("G:/My Drive/Research/beaches/data/processed")
write.csv(all_beaches, "./combined/All_beaches_new_120925.csv", row.names = FALSE)



```
